messages:
liam: Quick flag from int4 onboarding for v2.2-quant: small regression on 'table-extraction' slice (multi-cell tables).
anya: numbers?
liam: MRR down -0.028, p=0.043, n=1400. exact-match delta -0.012 p=0.18. latency +20% improvement p50. Link: https://console.redwood/testing/runs/2026-01-30/1729998888
eval-bot: auto-eval: slice=table-extract; n=1412; delta_mrr=-0.0281; p_mrr=0.043; ci=[-0.047,-0.009]; notes=some prompt templates with lots of sparsity driving variance.
anya: our gate currently hard-autofallbacks on mrr<-0.02 & p<0.05 for critical slices. This would block despite big latency wins.
liam: propose composite gate: allow exception path when latency_improve>=15% AND cost_improve>=15% => run 2h replicate offline replay + manual sign-off rather than immediate autofallback. If replicate confirms p<0.05 on MRR, then autofallback.
anya: also require secondary metric (exact) delta>-0.02 OR p>0.1 to qualify for exception. Otherwise immediate block.
release-bot: noted. Will page release lead if replicate confirms.
liam: I'll open a tiny rollout-config PR to switch hard_autofallback=false for preflight and add "replicate_then_manual" for econ-exceptions.
anya: nice. Also add dedupe of prompts and min_unique_docs=900 to avoid inflated n.
liam: action items: PR + replay tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
